output_text: In three back-to-back 2018 *Science* papers, the measured room-temperature thermal conductivity of cubic boron arsenide was reported to be between 1,000 and 1,300 W/(m·K), with values of approximately 1,300 W/(m·K) by Kang et al., 1,000 ± 90 W/(m·K) by Li et al., and 1,160 ± 130 W/(m·K) by Tian et al.
